pack.title: Crisis only friend
pack.description: Set a limit on emotional availability.

scenarios.setting: A friend calls for another long vent when you have no capacity tonight.
scenarios.jab: I need you right now. You always know what to say.
scenarios.goal: Set a limit on emotional availability.

replies.line: I can't talk tonight. I can check in tomorrow afternoon.
replies.why: It states your capacity and offers a specific time you can genuinely give.
replies.delivery: Keep the care sincere and the time specific; offer only the availability you can honor.

replies.why: It gives a clear limit and a real alternative.
replies.delivery: Keep the care sincere and the time specific; offer only the availability you can honor.

replies.line: I care about you; I don't have the energy for a long call tonight, but tomorrow afternoon works.
replies.why: It makes care and limited capacity compatible rather than treating them as opposites.
replies.delivery: Keep the care sincere and the time specific; offer only the availability you can honor.

replies.line: My listening battery needs charging; tomorrow afternoon?
replies.why: A gentle metaphor explains capacity without making the friend's feelings the joke.
replies.delivery: Keep the care sincere and the time specific; offer only the availability you can honor.

followUp.line: You matter to me; tonight's limit is about my capacity, not your worth.
followUp.why: It rejects the hurtful interpretation while keeping the limit.
followUp.delivery: Keep the care sincere and the time specific; offer only the availability you can honor.
